text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"One evening, after finishing our meeting
for the next race, I was walking Mejiro Ardan
back to her dorm when..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ah, I... just now.
choice_data_list: You looked like you were about to burst into dance!
You looked like you were about to start dancing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
Maybe... I just want to dance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Actually... I just couldn't forget
the thrill of the droit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A dance party commonly known as the "Droits"...
It is held every March in the gymnasium.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Every now and then, my body aches, so to speak...
I feel an urge to dance a step or two."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Just like a child, aren't you?
I will be sure to cool your head down before bedtime.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching Mejiro Ardan,
I suddenly felt a mischievous urge well up inside me.
choice_data_list: ...Want me to help you cool down?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...And so, inviting Mejiro Ardan to dance was all well and good, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, look at me.
Please, feel free to surrender yourself to me...♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Swept up by a dance she wasn't used to...
before she knew it, Mejiro Ardan was taking the lead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Are you all right?
choice_data_list: That takes quite a bit of stamina...
That takes quite a lot out of you, doesn't it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...You're right.
However, I...—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
What should I do? Far from calming down...
my heart is throbbing even faster now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan doesn't seem to have danced enough yet.
If only there were a partner who could truly satisfy her—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I saw Onee-sama's... my sister's droit,
I have been preparing the base.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, are you about to wrap—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: With Sister...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If I could dance with Mejiro Ramonu, it might satisfy not just the ache of this very moment... but also everything that has come before.
choice_data_list: As you are now, I think you can take the lead.
As you are now, I think you could take the lead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...
Indeed. If it were now—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...It may be a bit dramatic, but...
Will you bear witness?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —...Just an ordinary night.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Hey, Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Only the sound of your footsteps echoing.
A quiet, tedious night...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Did you not notice?
These footsteps signal the end of boredom—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —Would you please take my hand?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Are you truly prepared to beg?
You came here because you steeled your resolve, didn't you? If so—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Go ahead, try and snatch it away from me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ――...Hey, Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I understand, dear sister...!
The real challenge begins now...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu toyed with her, while Mejiro Ardan refused to let go...
The breath-taking intensity of the two sisters dancing as if challenging one another was awe-inspiring—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Heh.
Your fervor... is just about ripe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Next time, let us dance—upon the turf.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...I will take the lead then as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan doesn't seem to have danced enough yet.
If only there were a partner who could truly satisfy her—

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O & Yaeno
text_block_list.text: Then I will!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O-san, Yaeno-san!
What brings you here?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And that outfit is...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I saw the two of you, and...
I just couldn't sit still any longer!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I saw Chiyono O-san running off, so I rushed to change and come here.

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O & Yaeno
text_block_list.text:
Come, let us dance!
Come, let us run!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
!?
Aren't you going to race...?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
We're dancing~!
This is a Droit dress, you know!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ardan-san! Um... that's not fair!
N-Not remembering me right away!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"If you're going to unleash that fiery passion...
I want you to direct it at me!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Chiyono O-san...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It might be presumptuous of me,
but I brought an outfit for you too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"If you would take this hand—
Won't you please accept it?!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, of course.
Please give me... your passion as well.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...If we are talking about heat, passion,
I would certainly like to be included."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, I am well-versed in dance.
...Please, join me for a session!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Thank you very much.
Well then—shall we?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Mejiro Ardan changed into a suit.
The three rivals then moved to a new location...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
For the Droite... would it be a pair dance?
...How are the three of us supposed to dance together?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"How about we take turns?
First, Chiyono O-san and I will--"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"The more carrots, the merrier!"
Why not all three of us?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that sounds like an intriguing experiment.
In that case... I'll take the lead for all of us♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The peaceful moments shared by the three, who showed
such fierce competition on the track... continued until close to curfew.
